title: Orchestrated version transition safety harness for private control planes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automation harness and Terraform IaC patterns that enable deterministic, observable, and reversible control plane version transitions for Private (VPC) deployments. This ticket covers the control-plane side (version skus, health probes, staged promotion logic) and the Terraform modules that drive staged promotion across tenant pools. The goal is to reduce manual coordination for private cluster upgrades, shorten mean time to safe promotion, and provide auditable gates for enterprise customers.
motivation: Customers running Private control planes require predictable, auditable upgrades with minimal blast radius. Current manual upgrade playbooks are slow and error-prone. By encoding staged canary promotion logic in the upgrade controller and IaC modules we can achieve repeatable upgrades with automated rollbacks and clear telemetry-driven gates.
scope: Author a versioned Terraform module (private_controlplane_upgrade) that can declaratively define canary cohorts, promotion policies, and rollback thresholds
Enhance the control plane upgrade-controller to support: cohort scheduling, shadow-validation traffic, canary health gates, compatibility matrix checks, and automatic rollbacks

Define and implement a small set of health gates derived from existing telemetry (error_rate, tail_latency_p95, reconciliation_errors, api_coverage) and expose them as configuration in the Terraform module
Create preflight validation jobs that run integration smoke tests in a traffic-shadow environment before promotion
Add audit logs + change events to the private control plane for post-mortem and compliance auditing
Create CI automation to generate terraform change PRs and link to internal runbooks/dashboards
success_criteria: Terraform module published and versioned (registry entry) with examples and module_docs.md
Upgrade-controller accepts a declarative promotion policy and executes a 3-stage canary promotion in an internal testsite without manual intervention
Automatic rollback triggers and executes when any configured gate breaches for 5m sustained window
Preflight smoke tests run in shadow mode and produce pass/fail artifacts surfaced in Console
Audit events for each promotion step are written to the private controlplane audit log and visible in the Console activity stream
Documentation: runbook + post-upgrade verification checklist + example tenant manifests
deliverables: upgrade-controller: cohort-promotion feature branch merged and deployed to canary environment
prometheus/alert rules and Grafana dashboard panels for upgrade gates
runbook PR and release notes for private-controlplane-2026.03
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect gate thresholds cause unnecessary rollbacks => Mitigation: start with conservative thresholds and expose an override flag; require manual approval for first two production promotions
Risk: Terraform drift between private tenants => Mitigation: add a terraform plan/check job and a drift-detection alert before promotion
Risk: Shadow testing may not surface data-plane regressions => Mitigation: include a subset of synthetic traffic that exercises KV-cache hot paths and typical seq-len profiles
Risk: Sensitive environment changes require security review => Mitigation: flag security_review_required and schedule early review with security team
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - dry-run: create terraform module + unit tests; run upgrade-controller in simulated mode against local k8s; duration 2 weeks
Phase 1 - internal canary: pick 3 non-customer tenant namespaces in staging, execute 3-stage promotion with shadow validation and smoke tests; monitor for 1 week
Phase 2 - pilot customers: coordinate with 2 low-risk customers for pilot upgrade; schedule maintenance window and full observability; manual approval required for first pilot
Phase 3 - gradual rollout: enable automatic promotions with telemetry gates across remaining private tenants, start at 5% then 25% then 100% over N days
Rollback: immediate rollback to previous control plane image if any gate breaches sustained window; automation must create a rollback PR and record rationale in audit log
notes: Decided to separate IaC from controller logic: Terraform publishes cohort config; controller interprets and executes promotions
We will reuse existing telemetry metrics: private_api_error_rate, controlplane_sync_latency_p95, reconciliation_failures_count
Consider adding a lightweight compatibility-check job that validates CRD schemas across versions before promotion
Security to review KMS/HSM interactions for rollout artifacts and change events
